Atari will provide the Rom at no charge if the old part is returned within 90 days of the date we ship. Parts not returned within 90 days will be charged to your account at $10.00 each. Please call your orders in as you require the parts.
We recommend that you: 1. Charge your operators for the parts on a Credit Upon Return basis.
2. Advise your operators of this offer and give them a firm date that their roms must be returned.
